# geoaeo

> a free, open-source CLI, MCP server, and library that audits any site for SEO, GEO, and AEO, scores it 0-100, and generates llms.txt, sitemaps, JSON-LD, WebMCP, and Markdown mirrors.

## Product

geoaeo is a free, open-source CLI, MCP server, and library that audits any site for SEO, GEO, and AEO, scores it 0-100, and generates llms.txt, sitemaps, JSON-LD, WebMCP, and Markdown mirrors..

## Free tools

- [Site audit](https://usegeoaeo.com/tools): Score any URL 0-100 for SEO, GEO, and AEO.
- [llms.txt generator](https://usegeoaeo.com/tools): Generate an llms.txt for your site.
- [JSON-LD generator](https://usegeoaeo.com/tools): Generate schema.org structured data.
